SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
WHERE s.file_id = (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'core' AND package = 'click')
  AND s.qualname LIKE 'Group.%'
  AND cb.base_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE qualname = 'Command')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.symbols base_cmd
    WHERE base_cmd.qualname = 'Command'
      AND base_cmd.file_id = s.file_id
      AND base_cmd.line_start <= s.line_start
      AND base_cmd.line_end >= s.line_end
  )
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
WHERE s.file_id = (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'core' AND package = 'click')
  AND s.qualname LIKE 'Group.%'
  AND cb.base_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE qualname = 'Command')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.symbols base_cmd
    WHERE base_cmd.qualname = 'Command'
      AND base_cmd.file_id = s.file_id
      AND base_cmd.line_start <= s.line_start
      AND base_cmd.line_end >= s.line_end
  )
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
